d: Iran has stepped up drone attacks on Bahrain, with the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps claiming to have targeted US-operated radar installations at military bases across the Gulf kingdom. From Isa Air Base to the Al-Riffa helicopter base, the renewed strikes have raised concerns about the security of American military assets and Bahrain's strategic importance as the home of the US Fifth Fleet headquarters.
